annotations.title: Tip calculator: tip, total and split per person

description: Tip and total for a bill at a tip percentage, split between any number of people, optionally rounding each share up to the next whole amount. Use for receipts, expense apps and group payments. Example: bill=84.5. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

roundUp.description: true to round each share up to a whole amount
